title: Expand README with full project documentation
approach: Create a backup of the current README, then programmatically gather content from architecture, entry point, requirements, routing, models, store, CI workflow, and other meta files. Assemble a structured Markdown file with badges, TOC, architecture diagram, installation, usage, API reference, data model, persistence, testing guide, contribution/CI notes, and licensing links. Replace the original README with the generated version and ensure all relative links are correct.
tests_to_write: test_readme_structure.py: verifies that the generated README contains required sections (Title, Badges, Table of Contents, Installation, Usage, API Reference, Data Model, Persistence, Testing, CI/Contributing, License).
test_readme_links.py: checks that all relative markdown links in README resolve to existing files in the repository.
test_readme_backup.py: ensures that a backup file README.backup.md is created before the README is overwritten.
edge_cases: Missing .agent/architecture.md – fallback to a minimal textual architecture description.
Both app.py and src/app.py exist – detect which entry point is used in the project (by checking if __main__ block runs) and document the correct command.
Requirements.txt is empty or missing – provide a graceful note indicating manual dependency installation.
No LICENSE or CODE_OF_CONDUCT files – skip badge generation and add a placeholder notice.
